events.title: UNIVAC I delivered
events.summary: Remington Rand delivered the first UNIVAC I to the U.S. Census Bureau on June 14, 1951 — the first commercial computer produced in the United States.
events.about: UNIVAC I used mercury delay-line memory and vacuum tubes to process business and government data — payroll, statistics, and election-night predictions. It proved computers could be sold as products, not one-off lab machines. Mainframe batch processing and COBOL-era enterprise computing trace their commercial roots here.

narrative.whyChosen: UNIVAC I was the first commercially produced computer in the U.S.
narrative.whyImportant: It established the computer industry as a business — not just government and university research.
narrative.problemSolved: Organizations needed reliable electronic data processing beyond hand-tabulated punch cards.
